crew.overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.
crew.title: Life in a Year

details.biography:
Involved in the film industry for over two decades, Allan has been working in various roles from post-production to being on set. Currently employed as a digital technician for both feature films and series projects. In addition to his technical work, he has co-created a children's series, produced and directed commercials and short films, and dabbles in writing during his free time.

"Independent film is something that should be cherished and supported. Not just by funding, but with encouragement, and resources. It’s a craft of passion led by the next wave of storytellers and filmmakers, that can open our minds and explore new ideas or realities. Wouldn’t it be great to go to the theatre to see an award-winning short before the next blockbuster? I think so, but that’s just me." - A.W.
details.name: Allan Wylie
